prompt: A beautiful and informative data visualization for a report on global deforestation. The main visual could be a world map where countries are colored based on their rate of forest loss, or a series of stylized tree graphics where the number of leaves represents the remaining forest cover. The design should be impactful and emotionally resonant, not just a dry chart, demonstrating the ability to turn data into a compelling visual story. –ar 16:9
